newsitem.title: USA: Wabash completes Fruehauf assets purchase.
newsitem.headline: Wabash completes Fruehauf assets purchase.

text.p: Wabash National Corp said Thursday it completed the purchase of certain assets of Fruehauf Trailer Corp for $51 million.

Assets purchased include the Fruehauf and Pro-Par names, all patents and trademarks, retail outlets in 31 metropolitan markets, the aftermarket parts distribution business based in Grove City, Ohio, a specialty trailer manufacturing plant in Huntsville, Tenn. and a trailer plant in Fort Madison, Iowa.
The retail outlets will operate under the name of Fruehauf Trailer Services Inc, a wholly owned subsidiary of Wabash National Corp.
